items.title: Free Greek Key Border Scroll Medallion DXF Door Panel
items.description: A crisp Greek key meander frames the panel edges while two elegant scroll flourishes anchor the top and bottom corners around a central circular floral medallion. The mix of geometric border and flowing scrollwork gives this design a refined, classical architectural character.

items.title: Free Diamond Damask Trellis DXF Panel for CNC Doors
items.description: A dense diamond-grid trellis is overlaid with baroque scroll and leaf motifs at each diagonal intersection, producing a rich, textile-inspired all-over pattern. The diagonal orientation of the grid gives this panel a more dynamic, energetic feel than a straight horizontal or vertical damask layout.
